tools.name: trending_now
tools.description: Newest Google trending searches for 1-5 countries (ISO-2 codes): query, approximate traffic, start time, first seen today, other countries where it trends, news links.

tools.name: trending_day
tools.description: Every trending search seen on one UTC day (today or the last 30 days) for 1-5 countries, biggest first, with first/last seen, peak traffic and news.

tools.name: cross_country_trends
tools.description: Topics trending right now in 2+ of the 30 countries, most countries first.

tools.name: topic_history
tools.description: Search the last 30 days of trending searches for a topic; returns each matching search with the countries, first seen, last day seen and peak traffic.

tools.name: countries
tools.description: The 30 country codes, names and last read time.
